RbxThumbUtils.luau.description: Wraps the rbxthumb URL api surface to generate a URL for a thumbnail on the cloud. These thumbnails are automatically batched for performance. Public entry points include `RbxThumbUtils.getThumbnailUrl`, `RbxThumbUtils.avatarItemTypeToThumbnailType`, `RbxThumbUtils.getAssetThumbnailUrl`, `RbxThumbUtils.getAvatarThumbnailUrl`, `RbxThumbUtils.getAvatarHeadShotThumbnailUrl`, `RbxThumbUtils.getBadgeIconThumbnailUrl`,…
